platform_genre: Isometric action hack-and-slash roguelite (real-time manual combat: attack/special/cast/dash + one god-power call) by Supergiant Games. Single-player, story-driven; you play Zagreus escaping the Underworld through a fixed 4-region gauntlet (Tartarus -> Asphodel -> Elysium -> Styx) ending at a set final boss. Runs ~20-40 min. Platforms: PC (Steam/Epic, EGS timed exclusive then Steam), Switch, PS4/PS5, Xbox, and iOS via Netflix Games. This is the closest premium, narrative-forward analog to Abyssal Lantern's manual action-roguelite pivot. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hades_(video_game) , https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145360/Hades/ , https://hades.fandom.com/wiki/Hades_Wiki
difficulty_ceiling_endless: Hades has NO endless/wave-survival mode and NO NG+ that adds new maps -- yet it solved the finite-ceiling problem entirely through the PACT OF PUNISHMENT / HEAT system, the single best model for GAP-A. After your first clear, the Pact unlocks (available from the start in 'Hell Mode'). It exposes ~15 selectable 'Conditions' (16 in Hell Mode), many multi-tier, each adding a fixed amount of 'Heat' (e.g. tougher enemies, faster foes, timed rooms 'Tight Deadline', less healing 'Damage Control', restricted boon choices, a boss with extra phases). Total achievable Heat by maxing every condition is 63; most players target 32 Heat, the milestone that awards the final Skelly cosmetic. Rewards (Titan Blood, Diamonds, Ambrosia) are gated by clearing at a given Heat: once you clear Heat N with a weapon, that weapon must run Heat N+1 to earn the next reward -- a self-authored, self-paced difficulty ladder replayed over the SAME fixed content. Crucially Heat is tracked PER WEAPON (all 6 Infernal Arms), stretching one content set across dozens of escalating clears. Sources: https://hades.fandom.com/wiki/Pact_of_Punishment , https://www.thegamer.com/hades-heat-guide-pact-of-punishment/ , https://gamerant.com/hades-pact-of-punishment-heat-explained/
fail_forward_meta: Every death is progress on THREE axes, making Hades the genre's canonical fail-forward design. (1) MIRROR OF NIGHT: 'Darkness' collected each run is spent on permanent, respec-able base upgrades (bonus HP, extra Dash charges, 'Death Defiance' revives, boon-reroll 'Fated Persuasion', 'Gods' Legacy' raising Duo/Legendary rates); each talent has a two-sided alternate you toggle for playstyle, and a full reset costs only Chthonic Keys, so meta power is customizable, not one-way. (2) NECTAR & KEEPSAKES: gifting Nectar to an NPC the first time yields a KEEPSAKE -- an equippable run trinket (guarantee a specific god's boons, +HP, damage buffs) that LEVELS UP with use across runs. (3) STORY-AS-PROGRESSION: the plot only advances back at the House of Hades between runs; win OR lose, characters deliver reactive, voice-acted dialogue keyed to your last run. The credits trigger after 10 successful escapes; the true EPILOGUE is gated on relationships (max bonds with >=6 Olympians via Nectar/Ambrosia), typically 50-100+ total runs. So death literally cannot waste a run -- resources, keepsake XP, and narrative all accrue. Sources: https://hades.fandom.com/wiki/Mirror_of_Night , https://hades.fandom.com/wiki/Keepsakes , https://fextralife.com/hades-how-to-get-the-true-ending/ , https://screenrant.com/hades-true-ending-epilogue-how-get/
build_depth_and_solved_build_defense: Deep and structurally resistant to a single solved build -- the direct antidote to GAP-C. Power comes from BOONS drafted from randomized Olympian gods across a run; you hold limited slots (Attack/Special/Cast/Dash/Call + others), so you can never assemble every piece of a 'perfect' build. Depth stacks four ways: (a) 6 weapons x multiple ASPECTS each rewrite the weapon's identity, so a Zeus/Dionysus core that dominates on the Chiron Bow does nothing on the Twin Fists; (b) additive vs MULTIPLICATIVE damage math means understanding layering beats copying a guide; (c) DUO BOONS (two-god combos) and LEGENDARY boons act as force-multiplier payoffs but only appear once you hold specific PREREQUISITE boons from those gods -- they are earned by intentional drafting, not handed out; (d) RNG is mitigated by AGENCY via Keepsakes (force a god's pool), Fated Persuasion (reroll offers), and Gods' Legacy (raise rare-boon odds). Community consensus: you pick a core playstyle and ADAPT to offers rather than force one 'meta' build, because forcing usually underperforms. Strong builds exist but are weapon/aspect-conditional and RNG-gated, so no one build trivializes all content. Sources: https://hades.fandom.com/wiki/Boons , https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2251267674 , https://www.reddit.com/r/HadesTheGame/ , https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hades_(video_game)
retention_return_hook: Return is driven by INTRINSIC pull, not a daily/FOMO loop -- Hades has NO login rewards, NO daily quests, NO timers. Players come back for: (1) the never-ending reactive STORY -- credits at 10 clears, epilogue at 50-100+ runs, plus continual new dialogue keyed to weapon/boons/relationships, so 'one more run to see what they say' is the hook; (2) the self-set HEAT ladder giving an always-higher personal goal over the same maps; (3) weapon/aspect mastery and unlock chase (aspects bought with Titan Blood earned only at rising Heat); (4) build experimentation across the huge boon space. This proves a premium single-player roguelite can sustain 100+ hour retention with ZERO recurrent-engagement mechanics -- highly relevant to Abyssal Lantern's non-monetized, no-daily stance. Sources: https://davideaversa.it/blog/hades-narrative-design/ , https://www.reddit.com/r/HadesTheGame/ , https://hades.fandom.com/wiki/Pact_of_Punishment
monetization_context: Premium buy-to-play with ZERO microtransactions and NO live-service mechanics -- the same ethos as Abyssal Lantern's 'no monetization ever' stance. Sold ~1M copies by Sept 2020 shortly after v1.0 (~700k of those during Early Access), with third-party estimates placing lifetime sales far higher across platforms [uncertain -- Supergiant does not disclose updated totals]. The iOS release (Mar 19 2024) shipped exclusively through Netflix Games: included at no extra charge with a Netflix subscription and, per Supergiant, free of microtransactions, ads, or hidden fees; supports cloud saves, achievements, custom touch controls, and Bluetooth controllers. At that time it was iOS-only with no Android version [uncertain -- may have changed post-2024]. Takeaway: a content-complete premium package (no recurrent spend) is a proven, critically lauded model, validating Abyssal Lantern's refusal of monetization. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hades_(video_game) , https://www.supergiantgames.com/games/hades/ , https://www.gamesbeat.com/hades-netflix-ios/ , https://www.sensortower.com/
community_praise: Universally acclaimed (Steam 'Overwhelmingly Positive'; multiple 2020 GOTY awards; first video game to win a Hugo Award). Praised for: tight, readable, telegraphed manual combat that rewards dodge/dash mastery ('the dance'); the landmark fusion of roguelite structure with a cohesive, ever-evolving story where FAILURE advances the plot ('ludonarrative harmony'); an enormous volume of reactive, fully voice-acted dialogue that makes the world feel alive; huge build variety via boons/weapons/aspects; and exceptional art, music, and polish. Reviewers repeatedly credit it with 'solving' the roguelite-narrative problem. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hades_(video_game) , https://davideaversa.it/blog/hades-narrative-design/ , https://www.reddit.com/r/HadesTheGame/
community_complaints: (1) HEAT CLIMB IS A TEDIOUS PER-WEAPON SLOG: rewards require clearing each Heat level one-by-one for EACH of 6 weapons, and skipping levels is not rewarded -- widely called a 'slog' that discourages experimentation. (2) At high Heat (~32+) some feel the game becomes a 'slot-machine' dictated by boon RNG rather than skill, and certain Pact conditions are 'no-fun' modifiers that just restrict choices. (3) FIXED region/boss sequence gets 'stale' over long play; grind for aspects/mirror/story can feel like 'artificial padding.' (4) Boon BALANCE: some combos trivialize bosses while other gods feel underwhelming/'bland'; bad boon RNG can sink an attempt, breeding resentment on hard runs. Sources: https://www.reddit.com/r/HadesTheGame/ , https://steamcommunity.com/app/1145360/discussions/ , https://hawkdove.io/hades-review/
relevance_to_abyssal: GAP-A (finite ceiling) -- ADOPT the Heat/Pact model as a self-selected difficulty ladder layered OVER Abyssal Lantern's fixed 3 stages (Cinder Span -> Abyss Chancel -> Echo Throne) with NO new content authored. Concretely: after the first Echo Throne clear, unlock a 'Pact'-style menu of stackable Conditions (enemy +dmg/+speed, room timers, healing caps, reduced skill slots, boss extra-phase) each adding a Heat value; gate a repeatable reward (Echo Shard bonus / cosmetic) on clearing at each new Heat tier. This gives Warden-Level-60 power a permanent CONTENT ceiling to spend against and is fully compatible with our deterministic 60Hz seed sim (Conditions are static multipliers on the existing PCG, not new RNG). Evidence: Hades sustains 100+ hrs on 4 fixed regions purely via Heat (max 63; 32-Heat Skelly milestone). AVOID Hades' per-weapon Heat tracking that players call a 'slog' -- Abyssal Lantern has ONE loadout, so track Heat GLOBALLY (one ladder), sidestepping the #1 Heat complaint. GAP-B (retention / why-come-back) -- ADOPT Mirror-of-Night + story-as-progression as an INTRINSIC return hook that needs no daily/FOMO loop, matching our non-monetized design: make the meta (Warden Level, respec-able skill talents, Echo Shard upgrades) plus narrative beats advance on EVERY run including defeats (we already carry 40% XP + 100% Shard on death -- lean into it as canonical fail-forward). Add reactive between-run dialogue/story milestones gated on cumulative clears and Heat reached so 'one more run to see what's next' pulls players back. Evidence: Hades' credits at 10 clears and relationship-gated epilogue at 50-100+ runs drive retention with ZERO daily mechanics. GAP-C (solved-build risk) -- Hades resists a dominant build via limited slots + weapon/aspect-conditional value + PREREQUISITE-GATED synergy payoffs (Duo/Legendary). ADOPT the prerequisite-gating pattern for our 20-skill/tier tree: make the strongest T3 effects require holding specific T1/T2 combinations across DIFFERENT categories (e.g. a melee-amp T3 that only spikes when paired with a specific mobility T2), so power lives in emergent cross-category combos rather than one always-best skill -- and scale Heat Conditions to punish the current dominant build (mirror Hades' boon-restriction pacts). This preserves determinism (fixed prerequisite rules, not RNG drafts) while breaking the single-solved-build trap that plagued Vampire Survivors / 20 MTD / HoloCure in prior research. AVOID pure-RNG boon offers (in tension with our deterministic sim) -- take the STRUCTURE (gated synergies, self-selected difficulty), not the randomness. Sources: https://hades.fandom.com/wiki/Pact_of_Punishment , https://hades.fandom.com/wiki/Mirror_of_Night , https://hades.fandom.com/wiki/Boons , https://www.reddit.com/r/HadesTheGame/
